answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 68 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 68 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 560 sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the sonnet here is verification, the garden of cost is what stops the farm, and the ridge of the record keeps every claim checkable.
